scope: All20 tracked text blobs read, no tracked images or binaries. GPL3 full-file comparison documented in manifest.

manifest.review: Full-file diff against previously whole-read audio399 LICENSE; only heading whitespace and trailing blank line differ; all hunks read.

findings: README describes WIP Steam image/video/asset similarity via perceptual hashing/embeddings, but no corresponding algorithm, vector index, media decoding or matching implementation exists in tracked source.

Executed original CacheBucket and ObjectCacheProvider unchanged under net10 adapter: static isWeakReference changes mode globally. Writing a second bucket in opposite mode makes first unreadable although its referent is kept alive. Both directions reproduced.
ConcurrentDictionary does not synchronize mutable bucket fields, CacheHits increments, clearing or concurrent read/write; no atomic snapshot contract. Source finding, no stress qualification.

Cleanup over capacity takes a subset to inspect but removes only stale/dead items, so maximum size is not a hard cap. Second OrderByDescending replaces primary ordering; valid pointers receive -1 and invalid entries their hits. Monitor.Exit attempted even when TryEnter fails. Source only.

Import snapshots existing IDs once and never adds newly queued IDs; repeated input IDs are not filtered. No unique steam_appid index implemented; EnsureIndexesAsync empty. Mongo concurrency/duplicate behavior not executed.

JSON parsing before per-line try aborts importer for malformed JSON; batch write errors swallowed and batch cleared, totalAdded counts input before successful writes. No durable acknowledgement/retry contract.
StoreApp upserts do not invalidate ID cache; default30second stale IDs possible. Mutable list returned directly.

SteamAPI allowCache=false bypasses object cache but still reads fresh file; writes AppList.json directly before deserialization without atomic replacement, bounded size, cancellation or cleanup; returned streams are not disposed. HTTP status not ensured; no API calls executed.
TestAddFromFileJSONLines is importer, not assertion-based test. csproj Tests folder is empty declaration. No tracked test suite or benchmark, upstream net7 executable not built/run.
Programs use fixed local Mongo database and hard-coded Windows import path. No database, network scraper, collection mutation or file import executed.
PowerShell method listing requests RegexOptions.Global absent from .NET enum; source only, script not executed.

local_comparison.finding: Local cache owns per-instance BTreeMap values, no weak/strong global mode. Keys include content digest, recipe digest and frame index; explicit max_entries rejects new keys at capacity. Atomic publication implemented. This is source comparison, not new runtime qualification or proof of all cache cases.

adoption: No source copied or production changes; reject-domain retained. Cache ownership and acknowledgement requirements retained as review evidence.
